lane:
قُنَّبِيطٌ : see art. قنبط.

قُنَّبِيطٌ [_Cauliflower;_] the _thickest species of_ كُرُنْب; (K;) called in the dial. of Egypt قَرْنَبِيطٌ; mentioned in the S in art. قبط; [but only as a thing well known;] the author of the S regarding the ن as augmentative: (TA:) _it renders the breath stinking; and causes a thickness,_ or _grossness,_ [app. _of the humours;_] _and she who uses its seed in the manner of a suppository in the vagina will not become pregnant:_ (K:) so say the physicians. (TA.)

entries.text: القنبيط، بالضم وفتح النون المشددة: أغلظ أنواع الكرنب، مبخر، مغلط، ومحتملة بزره لا تحبل. ومحمد بن الحسين القنبيطي: محدث.
